Subject: Transfer: VerdantAI - Sales→CS kickoff & initial implementation agenda

Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround to accept the handoff. VerdantAI signed the order last week (PO issued; see SOW v3 attached). High level context and asks below so CS has everything to start sprint zero:

Deal snapshot
- ACV: $540K (annualized)
- Primary use: low-latency NLP reranking + embeddings serving for customer support search
- Go-live target: 2027-06-15 (soft go-live 2027-05-31 for a pilot of 10% traffic)
- Key constraints: HIPAA adjacency, EU data residency for logs, SAML SSO enforcement

Committed scope (per SOW v3)
- Dedicated cluster: 4x A5000 nodes for production, 2x for staging
- Model variants: rwd-instruct-13B-int8 for embeddings + rwd-chat-7B for routing
- 99th pct latency target (gen): < 200ms on production SLA tier

Immediate asks for sprint zero (owners suggested)
- Access & network: Verdant will provision a jump host and open IPs; need list of required ports and a test matrix. (Owner: Karthik)
- Data contracts & redaction: confirm retention + PII redaction approach. (Owner: Monica)
- SSO + provisioning: SAML metadata and IdP test user. (Owner: Tessa)
- Pilot acceptance criteria & test prompts: draft and signoff. (Owner: Dylan - will coordinate with Sam/Priya)

Known risks / internal notes
- Verdant's usage profile is bursty — recommend enabling conservative autoscaling thresholds initially to avoid cost overruns.
- They may request pre-production access to a dedicated KV-cache dump for offline evaluation — needs legal signoff.

Attachments included: VerdantAI_SOW_v3.pdf (latest redlines accepted), verdantai-initial-implementation-map.xlsx (high-level timeline + roles).

Next steps
1) Can CS confirm primary owner and a 30-minute kickoff window for Tue 2027-04-27 between 10–11 PT?
2) I'll share the HubSpot deal link and any remaining legal notes in the thread.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth handoff.

—
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
dylan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
